title: Printer won't do double-sided (duplex) printing
description: I'm printing HR forms as duplex output, but the printer always prints single-sided.

worklogs.description: Updated Duplex Unit = Installed under driver Device Settings.
Verified the driver version on the user's workstation: 7.83 (current).

comments.author: agent
comments.message: On the driver side I marked the Duplex Unit as 'Installed'. Could you do a test print now? In the Print dialog, do you see a 'Print on both sides' or 'Two-sided' option? Could you send a screenshot?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: The option showed up, I selected 'Long edge' but it still printed single-sided. I've attached the screenshot.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Thanks for the screenshot. I can see the options are set correctly. Now we need to check on the printer side: on the printer's panel under Menu > Settings > Default Print Settings, is 'Default Duplex' active? Also, is the duplex module physically installed (you can open the printer's rear cover to check)?
